architecture.path: interface -> runtime/service -> AgentSession(Investigation + Evidence + ObservationLedger + objective Decision/Progress state) -> Main Agent -> Runtime canonical preflight/tools -> provisional Final -> Claim Verifier -> accept OR runtime reopen/pin/feedback -> Main Agent
architecture.authority: Main Agent owns task semantics; Claim Verifier is the only independent semantic reviewer; Runtime owns contracts, objective state identity, Evidence/observation memory, canonical tool validation and physical authority; administrative structured-output probes remain transport-only
architecture.investigation_contract: runtime-owned canonical material targets updated transactionally by Main LLM additive deltas; id/goal are durable, committed Evidence is retained automatically, and semantic truth remains outside runtime authority
architecture.investigation_map: compact observable navigation history; separate from semantic investigation purpose
architecture.tool_call_effective_cap: progress-earned; no fixed cumulative extension ceiling
architecture.observation_ledger: same normalized observation + same workspace_epoch is executed once; later requests are replayed/rehydrated without physical tool cost; negative complete searches and symbol-not-found outcomes are citable observations
architecture.workspace_epoch: increments only when a verified workspace write commits; session/memory bookkeeping does not invalidate workspace observations
architecture.claim_rework_lane: only after Claim debt; exposes unused task-wide llm_call capacity while reserving one later verifier call and reports current/pending physical authority; does not raise the normal investigation cap

adaptive_structured_handshake.policy: provider enforcement is opportunistic; Eyle local validation is authoritative

investigation_contract.semantic_invariants: necessity, Evidence sufficiency, dismissal validity and missing material scope belong to the Main LLM/Claim Review, not runtime
investigation_contract.final_gate: project-grounded final requires a non-empty contract with no open target
investigation_contract.review_link: Semantic Gaps plus insufficient or contradicted Claims may explicitly carry target_id for an existing challenged target; null never authorizes runtime-created semantics
investigation_contract.evidence_pinning: target-linked Evidence keeps a compact ID/file/lines/hash pointer visible even after the recent Evidence window moves on

canonical_claim_review.local_recovery: Claim, Semantic Gap and Finding protocol recovery reuses the same claim_verifier only to correct its own invalid structured output; runtime never invents semantic judgments
canonical_claim_review.followup: contradicted, insufficient and semantic gaps use one deterministic route: reopen reviewer-declared targets, pin cited Evidence, return reviewer feedback to Main Agent
canonical_claim_review.loop_control: Decision Ledger fingerprints reviewer debt against canonical state; identical debt without material state change stops as CLAIM_REVIEW_STALLED
canonical_claim_review.producer_rule: Claim Verifier never rewrites final prose; semantic correction belongs only to Main Agent

tools.write_protocol: action=patches -> dry-run -> confirmation -> apply -> compile/tests/reread -> rollback on failure
tools.public_abi: canonical English model-facing fields; read_file(path), read_range(path,line_start,line_end), find_symbol(symbol,path?), list_tree(limit?,depth?,filter?), count_tokens(path?,tokenizer?); legacy aliases are rejected

rev5_2.added: persistent Investigation Contract in AgentSession and Claim Review
rev5_2.fixed: inspect_project observable summary now preserves the current *_signals schema instead of stale field names

p0_fixes: insufficient Claim can explicitly map to target_id and reopen exactly that target
semantic follow-up no-progress feedback never orders the agent to stop while review debt is pending
agent final payload is canonical answer+evidence_ids+limitations in provider schema and local parser
known post-followup Claim Review receives an elastic completion reserve sized from the already-observed prior review item count through the existing Claim Review budget logic
investigation contract decisions expose compact target state transitions in observable trace
rev5_2_1.authority_rule: LLM owns semantics/tool choice; runtime validates identities, state transitions, budgets and authority only

p0_fixes: completion reserve after semantic follow-up is exactly one configured verifier call rather than historical review-size projection
Main LLM declares workspace_scope none|read|write; legacy lexical request classifiers have no production authority
active-workspace non-chat final declared none receives fail-closed scope-only semantic review
open Investigation targets block patch proposals and confirmed write resume
persisted file Evidence is hash-validated and rehydrated on resume; stale coverage is released
persistence lock is OS-backed across processes
workspace read/search/symbol/Git surfaces share one secret path/content policy
rev5_2_2.authority_rule: LLM/reviewer own semantic classification; runtime validates declarations, identities, state transitions, safety and physical authority

p0_fixes: source coverage that suppresses rereads is current-prompt visibility, while historical coverage is observability only
Evidence referenced by insufficient Claims/semantic gaps or reopened targets is pinned across semantic follow-up
successful unchanged tools no longer count as progress merely because ok=true
project_stats, inspect_project, count_tokens and agent_info repeated unchanged observations are suppressed until a state-changing action
run_tests is keyed by scope and reused until an observable state-changing action invalidates the prior execution
rev5_2_3.authority_rule: LLM/reviewer own semantic direction; runtime tracks current visibility, objective result identity and physical state changes only

changes: every job starts with the unchanged 12-tool base fuse
Claim Review can earn +4 tool calls when structurally new supported material is verified while insufficient Claims or Semantic Gaps still require follow-up
earned bonus is capped at +8 in this release and duplicate supported Claim shapes cannot mint credit again
oversized tool batches are rejected atomically before any tool executes; Main LLM chooses the smaller subset
safe execution history exposes base/earned/effective tool budget and bonus cycles
history UI adds expand-all/collapse-all controls
rev5_2_4.authority_rule: Claim Review owns semantic support; runtime only deduplicates verified Claim identities, grants bounded physical credit and enforces budget atomically

changes: Claim Review no longer grants or influences tool credit; it remains only the second-brain semantic verifier of provisional final claims and target coverage
Main LLM sends investigation_updates deltas while runtime owns and preserves the canonical Investigation Contract
runtime applies valid target updates independently and persists accepted siblings even when another update is rejected
committed_progress is deposited only for structurally valid evidenced progress; multiple target updates in one LLM decision mint one progress epoch

earned tool extension is dormant runtime authority and is granted only when the physical tool gate would otherwise block an atomic batch, open debt remains, and new committed progress exists since the previous extension
committed Evidence cannot be silently dropped by later Main LLM updates
oversized batches remain atomic and the history UI retains expand-all/collapse-all while exposing committed progress and earned extensions
rev5_2_5.authority_rule: Main LLM owns meaning; runtime owns canonical contract state, partial commit and physical authority; Claim Review owns semantic verification only

changes: ObservationLedger becomes the runtime source of truth for deterministic physical observation identity by normalized call plus workspace_epoch
Main LLM may request the same observation again; runtime replays/rehydrates retained reality instead of physically rerunning it in the same workspace epoch
complete zero-match search_code and SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND become citable observation Evidence without runtime semantic interpretation
unified preflight validates phase/schema, suppresses batch duplicates, replays known observations and computes physical cost before earned tool authority
earned_extension can fund only genuinely novel physical calls after preflight
runtime-cycle progress accounting covers early continue/rejection paths and DecisionLedger stops repeated identical rejected batches as ADMINISTRATIVE_LOOP
legacy IDENTICAL_READ_BLOCKED, IDENTICAL_OBSERVATION_BLOCKED, SEMANTIC_READ_BLOCKED execution paths and the full-investigation snapshot fallback are removed
history exposes observation ledger size, replay/rehydration count, workspace epoch, repeated rejected decisions and runtime progress cycles
Claim Review remains byte-identical to Rev5.2.5
rev5_2_6.authority_rule: Main LLM owns meaning and may reconsider freely; runtime owns contracts, retained observable reality and physical authority; Claim Review owns semantic verification only

rev5_2_7.basis: Rev5.2.6 Observation Ledger & Unified Runtime Preflight
changes: removed claim_repair profile, schema, prompt, LLM entrypoint, config and persisted attempt state
contradicted joins insufficient and semantic gaps in the same reviewer-debt follow-up route
runtime reopens only verifier-declared target_id mappings, pins cited Evidence and returns compact reviewer feedback to Main Agent
Decision Ledger stops identical reviewer debt against unchanged canonical state as CLAIM_REVIEW_STALLED
directed Claim rework can consume only unused global max_llm_calls capacity and reserves one later verifier call; normal max_llm_turns remains 8
committed_progress credit now requires newly linked runtime Evidence; pure established status transitions cannot mint tool authority
local Claim protocol recovery now preserves target_id through merge
production structured semantic profiles are exactly agent and claim_verifier
rev5_2_7.authority_rule: Agent produces; Claim judges; Runtime administers. No third task-semantic LLM role exists.

rev5_2_8.basis: Rev5.2.7 Two-Brain Claim Follow-up & Loop Control
changes: Decision Ledger rejection identity includes objective observed state and relevant physical tool-authority state, preventing false ADMINISTRATIVE_LOOP after new observations or changed remaining authority
runtime progress ignores free-form Investigation status/reason churn and advances only from observed reality, Evidence bindings, committed progress or workspace mutation
invalid tool batches are rejected atomically before authority; phase policy remains the outer structural contract
public tool ABI uses one canonical English vocabulary and accepts no legacy aliases
Main Agent prompt persists material Evidence on open targets incrementally and favors independently provable target granularity
legacy lexical workspace/write helpers and semantic-read signature compatibility wrapper are removed
rev5_2_8.authority_rule: Agent thinks; Claim judges; Runtime administers objective contracts and physical reality. No new subsystem is introduced.

changes: removed the fixed +8 earned-tool ceiling; every unspent runtime-validated committed-progress epoch unlocks +4 physical calls exactly once at the authority gate
added durable global credit-once Evidence identity so old Evidence cannot mint progress again through reopen, remap or target cloning
investigation_updates.evidence_ids is additive delta and runtime automatically retains previously committed target Evidence
Claim follow-up reports remaining Agent-call capacity, current physical capacity and pending progress-funded capacity
normal 8-turn, 12-LLM-call and 12-tool base limits remain unchanged
rev5_2_9.authority_rule: Agent owns meaning; Claim judges; Runtime validates objective progress and converts each immutable progress epoch into +4 physical authority once.
